name: Riley Brooks
role: Round-up rider for the Refrigerator Car Co.
bio: Riley Brooks rode for the Refrigerator Car Co. in 1886, representing it at the Hashknife camp and gathering cattle on Crooked Creek and Grand River. In August 1886 he rode about eighteen miles in fifty-five minutes to report that George Fraser had been killed by lightning, and in December the paper announced his marriage to Lilly Roberts, then retracted the report as untrue.
